name: Gabriel
brief: An angel who delivers messages from God
short: Gabriel is an angel who appears in the Bible to deliver important messages from God, such as interpreting visions for Daniel (<ref="Dan.8.16; 9:21">Dan.8.16; 9:21</ref>) and announcing the births of John the Baptist and Jesus (<ref="Luke 1:19, 26">Luke 1:19, 26</ref>).
